# `tfctl api schema`

The `tfctl api schema` command group searches and inspects API operations from the OpenAPI spec.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl api schema <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl api schema` command group lets you search for API operations from the OpenAPI spec and inspect a single operation schema. Use these commands to discover available API endpoints and understand their request/response formats. Use the `search` subcommand to search for API operations by keyword, and the `get` subcommand to print out information about specific API calls.

## Subcommands

- [`get`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/api/schema/get) - Show API operation schema by operation ID or path
- [`search`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/api/schema/search) - Search API operations by keywords
